facts.fact: The World Bank's digital economy assessment states that there is currently no comprehensive digital strategy in the Central African Republic, and that most digital projects are run ad hoc by individual sector ministries (document dated 2020, no month given).
facts.system: stratégie numérique globale de la RCA

facts.fact: The assessment's SWOT lists a national digital strategy as in preparation, and says the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications commissioned technical assistance to support a comprehensive Digital CAR strategy, with the level of buy-in from other ministries unclear (document dated 2020, no month given).
facts.system: Plan National Stratégique de la Centrafrique Digitale à l'horizon 2025 (PNS CD 2025)

facts.fact: The assessment says the technical assistance for the Digital CAR strategy is financed under the Central African Backbone project, co-funded by the European Union and the African Development Bank; a feasibility study on the country's digital strategy was launched in 2020 under that project (document dated 2020, no month given).
facts.system: Plan National Stratégique de la Centrafrique Digitale à l'horizon 2025 (PNS CD 2025)
